title: Domain must not depend on Infrastructure
description: The Domain layer is the pure core of the fixture and must not take a compile-time dependency on the Infrastructure layer. The reviewed NetArchTest project tests/Sample.ArchTests is the executable body this locked contract hashes; the fixture ships an intentional violation (Sample.Domain.Order references Sample.Infrastructure.Database) so a real adapter run reports fail. lockedBodySha256 is the canonical Get-ArchLockedBodyHash digest over tests/Sample.ArchTests (build outputs excluded).

rules.description: Types in namespace Sample.Domain must not have a dependency on namespace Sample.Infrastructure.
